conventions: polygons[i] = [tileIdx, vid, vid, ...]  (tileIdx = row*10+col, loop of vertex ids, CCW)
portals[j] = [polyA, polyB, vidA, vidB]  (shared boundary segment / aggregated gate)
centroids[i] = [x, y] of polygon i (for A* heuristics)
tileLinks: {"rXcY|rZcW": [portalIdx, ...]} portals crossing tile seams (for hierarchical planning)
path: A* over polygons + funnel (string pulling) through portal gates = optimal smooth route
